N1.s: هر %lld جای رایگان را پر کرده‌اید. در کاتلینگ ادامه دهید؛ با خرید نسخه‌ی کامل، این یکی هم ذخیره می‌شود.
N1.back: every 5 place-of free (object) full you-have-made. in Cutling continue give; with buying-of version-of full, this one too saved becomes.
N1.why: Opens with S3's own words for the used-up places; «ادامه دهید» is the vocabulary file's continue word, and «این یکی هم» (this one too) names the item without repeating کاتلینگ beside the app's name.

N2.s: هر %lld جای رایگان را پر کرده‌اید. برای ذخیره‌ی بیشتر، نسخه‌ی کامل را در کاتلینگ بخرید.
N2.back: every 5 place-of free (object) full you-have-made. for saving-of more, version-of full (object) in Cutling buy.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1; «در کاتلینگ بخرید» (buy in Cutling) says where to go in two words, so the line stays near 90 characters.

N3.s: ذخیره شد؛ یک جای رایگان مانده
N3.back: saved became; one place-of free remained
N3.why: Short impersonal «ذخیره شد» is how Persian apps confirm a save; «مانده» without «است» is the natural clipped form for a one-line capsule.

N4.s: ذخیره شد؛ %1$lld از %2$lld جا پر شد
N4.back: saved became; 5 of 5 place full became
N4.why: «5 از 5» is the count order from S5; «free» is dropped as in K1 so the line fits a key-high capsule, and «پر شد» says the places are now full without a limit word.

N5.s: %1$lld از %2$lld پر؛ با خرید ذخیره می‌شود
N5.back: 5 of 5 full; with buying saved it-becomes
N5.why: Stated as what will happen, not a buy imperative, so the bar reassures that the item waits; the item is the understood subject, which Persian leaves out naturally, and the line stays near 32 characters.

N6.why: The verbal noun, as Persian labels buttons (S17 «بستن»), and the same verb as every unlock button in the first batch; a short word in the slot where «ذخیره» usually sits.

N7.s: هر %lld جای رایگان را پر کرده‌اید. با خرید نسخه‌ی کامل، این یکی هم برایتان ذخیره می‌شود.
N7.back: every 5 place-of free (object) full you-have-made. with buying-of version-of full, this one too for-you saved becomes.
N7.why: N1's sentence without the continue step, since the Share form has its own button; «برایتان» (for you) carries the brief's «for them».

N8.s: این یکی منتظر شماست. کاتلینگ را باز کنید و نسخه‌ی کامل را بخرید تا ذخیره شود.
N8.back: this one waiting-of you-is. Cutling (object) open do and version-of full (object) buy so-that saved it-becomes.
N8.why: The item is the subject («منتظر شماست», it is waiting for you), so nobody does the keeping: no «we», and no translated passive «نگه داشته شد»; «این یکی» is N7's word for the item, then the two steps in the order they happen.
